notes: The first then is added because the apodosis הוּא עָשָׂה is juxtaposed with no conjunction in it, while the second goes to the waw written in its own apodosis (rule 14).
it is not his hand that smote us is read as rule 20's cleft: the dummy and copula are one added unit and the cleft relative another, since a written verb already carries the predication.
